label: VERIFIED
extraction: Verification Loop: comprehensive verification system for Claude Code sessions with 6 phases. Phase 1: Build verification (npm/pnpm run build). Phase 2: Type check (tsc --noEmit or pyright). Phase 3: Lint check (npm run lint or ruff). Phase 4: Test suite with coverage (target 80% minimum). Phase 5: Security scan (grep for secrets, api_keys, console.log). Phase 6: Diff review (git diff --stat, review changed files for unintended changes, missing error handling, edge cases). Output format: VERIFICATION REPORT with PASS/FAIL per phase, overall READY/NOT READY for PR. Continuous mode: run every 15 minutes or after major changes. Integrates with PostToolUse hooks but provides deeper verification. Hooks catch issues immediately; this skill provides comprehensive review.
transfer_harness_fact: depends on W6 model freeze decision (D1)
